issue: Initial alpha-normalization renames unbound global/builtin names as well as locals; thus it is a heuristic hash that may collapse semantically different bool/str or other global operations.
impact: No candidate passed the canonical True/False domain gate, and these hashes did not cause an inclusion. Original phase02 files/freeze preserved.
correction: For further dedup use ordinary AST with docs/annotations removed and separate conservative alpha-local fingerprint preserving globals/builtins and attributes. Hashes are heuristics, not proofs of semantic equivalence; any eligible collision would need source/helper-closure adjudication.
